app.defaultTitle: SIWAT — Bring colour to what others make invisible

header.exitHint: You can also press Esc twice. To come back, press and hold the sun for 2 seconds.

footer.text: SIWAT is a preventive guidance tool. It does not file reports for you. If you are in physical danger right now, call {phone}.

emergency.title: If you are in danger now, call
emergency.body: Both lines are free. You decide what to share.

welcome.title: Is what you are facing online political violence? Find out in 2 minutes.
welcome.lead: Find out whether this is violence under Salvadoran law, back up your evidence safely and learn where to turn. You decide whether and when to report.
welcome.noticeBody: You do not need to give your real name. SIWAT guides you; it does not send reports to institutions for you.
welcome.consent: I understand that this is a guidance tool and I accept the privacy notice.
welcome.danger: I am in physical danger right now
welcome.exitTip: If someone comes near, tap {exit} or press Esc twice: you will see the weather. To come back, {hold}.
welcome.exitTipHold: press and hold the sun for 2 seconds
welcome.localSpaceCreate: Create a local space with a PIN (optional)
welcome.privacyBody: Your answers, links and screenshots are kept only in this browser's memory and are erased when you close the tab. Nothing is uploaded to servers. If you create a local space, it is stored encrypted with your PIN on this device. On the result screen you can erase everything with “Clear data from this device”.

localSpace.titleCreate: Create a local space with a PIN
localSpace.done: Done. Your progress is stored encrypted on this device. To pick it up another day, sign in with the same pseudonym and PIN.
localSpace.createIntro: This is optional. It stores your progress encrypted on this device only. Do not use your real name.
localSpace.openIntro: There is a saved space on this device. Enter your pseudonym and PIN to open it.
localSpace.replace: Create a new one (replaces the previous one)
localSpace.fallbackError: The local space could not be opened.

vault.invalid-credentials: Enter a pseudonym and a 4-digit PIN.
vault.not-found: There is no local space saved on this device.
vault.wrong-credentials: Incorrect pseudonym or PIN. Check them and try again.

evidence.too-many-files: You can upload up to {max} screenshots. Remove one to add another.
evidence.unsupported-format: “{name}” is not a JPG or PNG image. Upload the original screenshot in one of those formats.

identify.title: What happened, and where?
identify.role: In what role do you take part? (Optional)
identify.hint: These two answers are used only for anonymous statistics. They do not identify you.
identify.electoral: Is it happening during an election campaign or while you hold public office?
identify.conducts: Tick everything that has happened to you:
identify.errorPlatforms: Tick at least one network or channel where it happened.
identify.errorConducts: Tick at least one of the situations.

risk.stepLabel: Step 2 of 2: Urgency level and evidence
risk.title: Risk check and evidence backup
risk.threat: Have you received threats of physical or sexual harm, or against your family?
risk.exposure: Did they expose your exact address, workplace, personal phone number or intimate images without permission?
risk.importantBody: Before you block the person attacking you, save the original screenshot and the link. If you block first, you will lose access to the evidence.
risk.url: Link (URL) to the post or the attacker's profile (Optional)

uploader.fallbackError: The image could not be processed.

result.lawTitle: What does Salvadoran law say about your case?
result.lawOfficialNote: The official text of these laws is in Spanish.

bitacora.title: Evidence Log
bitacora.lead: A PDF with case code {code}, UTC date and time, the SHA-256 fingerprint of each screenshot, the link and the legal framework. Keep it together with your original, unedited files.
bitacora.ack: This document is a personal backup log. SIWAT does not file reports for you and does not replace legal proceedings before the FGR or the TSE.
bitacora.spanishNote: The log is generated in Spanish so that you can present it to Salvadoran institutions.
bitacora.downloaded: Log downloaded. Check your downloads folder.
bitacora.error: The PDF could not be created. Try again; if it keeps failing, remove the screenshots and upload them again.
bitacora.eraseHint: When you are done, erase everything SIWAT stored on this device: answers, links, screenshots and local space.
bitacora.confirmBody: Your answers, links, screenshots and the PIN-protected local space will be erased. This cannot be undone.
bitacora.notDownloaded: You have not downloaded your log yet.

route.title: Your action plan
route.step1: 1. Report it on the platform (do not just block)
route.howtoSave: Save the evidence first: a screenshot with the date, the account name and the link visible.
route.howtoConfirm: Take a screenshot of the report confirmation. Afterwards, if you want, block or restrict the account.
route.note: You decide whether to report. SIWAT does not send your data or file reports for you.
route.shieldSummary: Protect your accounts today (3 key steps)

reportLocation.facebook: Tap the three dots (…) on the post or profile and choose “Report”. Select the reason: harassment, impersonation or nudity.
reportLocation.whatsapp: Open the chat, tap the contact or group name and choose “Report”.
reportLocation.tiktok: Press and hold the video or tap “Share” and choose “Report”. On a profile, use the three dots.
reportLocation.x: Tap the three dots (…) on the post or profile and choose “Report”.
reportLocation.instagram: Tap the three dots (…) on the post, story or profile and choose “Report”.
reportLocation.youtube: Tap the three dots (⋮) on the video or comment and choose “Report”.
reportLocation.telegram: Open the profile, channel or message, tap the three dots and choose “Report”.
reportLocation.email: Do not delete the email: save it in full (“Download message” or “Show original”) and mark it as spam or phishing.
reportLocation.other: Look for the “Report” option next to the post or on the profile of the person attacking you.

two-step.label: Turn on two-step verification
two-step.detail: In the security settings of each network. That way nobody can get in, even with your password.

hide-contact.label: Hide your phone number and email
hide-contact.detail: So that only you can see them on your public profile.

sessions.label: Check your open sessions
sessions.detail: Close any you do not recognise and change your password if you see one that looks strange.

stats.title: Anonymous statistics (optional)
stats.optIn: I want to contribute anonymous data to the ANDRYSAS Political Violence Observatory.
stats.preview: This is everything that would be shared: no name, links, account of events or screenshots. In this demo it is not sent anywhere yet.

assistant.title: Quick assistant
assistant.intro: Choose what you need right now. It works without internet and without artificial intelligence.

capture.question: How do I take a screenshot that counts as evidence?
capture.s1: Capture the whole screen without cropping: the date, the time and the account name or username must be visible.
capture.s2: Copy the link to the post or profile (in the 3 dots, “Copy link”).
capture.s3: Also capture the profile of the person attacking you and, if there are any, the comments.
capture.s4: Do not edit it, crop it or forward it through a chat app: keep the original file.
capture.s5: Upload it in Step 2 of the traffic-light check to calculate its SHA-256 fingerprint and the UTC time.
capture.s6: Do all of this before blocking.

hide.question: How do I hide SIWAT if someone comes near?
hide.s1: Tap “QUICK EXIT” at the top right, or press Esc twice on a computer.
hide.s2: A San Salvador weather screen appears, with no mention of SIWAT.
hide.s3: To go back to where you were, press and hold the sun for 2 seconds.

shield.question: I want to secure my WhatsApp and Facebook now
shield.whatsapp1: Settings › Account › Two-step verification › Turn on. Create a 6-digit PIN.
shield.whatsapp2: Settings › Privacy: set “Profile photo”, “About” and “Groups” to “My contacts”.
shield.whatsapp3: Settings › Linked devices: log out of any you do not recognise.
shield.facebook1: Accounts Centre › Password and security › Two-factor authentication.
shield.facebook2: In the same section, “Where you're logged in”: log out of any strange sessions.
shield.facebook3: Profile › Contact info: set your phone number and email to “Only me”.

threats.label: Threats
threats.description: They say they will harm you or your family.

sexist-insults.label: Sexist insults or mockery
sexist-insults.description: They humiliate you for being a woman, for your body or your private life.

doxing.label: Sharing of private data (doxing)
doxing.description: They published your phone number, address or private photos without permission.

impersonation.label: Identity theft
impersonation.description: They created a fake account pretending to be you.

disinformation.label: Disinformation or coordinated attack
disinformation.description: Mass lies or many accounts attacking you to discredit your political work.

red.label: Red
red.title: Red light — High risk
red.body: There are serious signs of a threat to your physical safety, your privacy or of a computer crime. Immediate action and protection are needed.

yellow.label: Yellow
yellow.title: Yellow light — Digital political violence
yellow.body: What you are facing aims to discredit you or limit your political participation. Document it systematically and report it.

green.label: Green
green.title: Green light — Preventive alert
green.body: Early signs of harassment or symbolic violence. Do not normalise it; secure your accounts and keep a record.

legal.leiv-49-51: 3 to 10 years in prison for sharing or creating intimate/sexual content without consent through electronic means.
legal.leiv-50: 1 to 3 years in prison for publishing personal data that harms someone's honour or privacy.
legal.leiv-55-e: Penalises exposing a woman to imminent risk to her physical or emotional integrity.
legal.ledic-22-32: Penalises identity theft and the fraudulent use of computer data.
legal.leiv-55-c: Penalises discrediting or degrading women in spaces of political participation.
legal.leiv-55-c-d: Penalises mocking, discrediting or obstructing women's political participation.
legal.electoral-code-173-249: Prohibits smear or defamatory campaign propaganda.
legal.lie-20-23: Guarantees equality in the exercise of political rights.
legal.leiv-9: Recognises psychological, emotional and symbolic violence against women.
legal.leiv-55-a: Penalises spreading messages that promote hatred or contempt towards women.
legal.belem-do-para-3-7: The right to a life free of violence in public and political life.

institutions.pnc: Emergencies and risks to your physical safety or that of your family.
institutions.fgr: Investigates threats, doxing and identity theft.
institutions.isdemu: Free guidance for women facing violence.
institutions.tse: Political violence during an election campaign or while holding office.
